<h1 id="king-black-dragon-basic" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>King Black Dragon Basic</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/RHEqJmlz7S.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>A powerful three-headed dragon residing north-west of the Edgeville lodestone. The King Black Dragon (KBD) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213018054852648.png?v=1" alt="kbd" title="kbd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is an iconic lower-level boss suitable for players with tier 50-70 gear. His attacks involve dealing with high-damage Dragonfire and other elemental breath attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Melee attacks</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ The King Black Dragon can bite or swipe at the player, dealing up to 1,000 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage.
    • The player can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551452788269127.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommelee" title="protectfrommelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to reduce this damage.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Fire Breath</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ The King Black Dragon can use regular dragonfire, hitting up 4,000 typeless damage
    • The player should: use dragonfire protection, like super antifire potions </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492695997513748.png?v=1" alt="superantifire" title="superantifire" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to strongly reduce this damage.
        • If F2P: use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551456835768351.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommagic" title="protectfrommagic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (recommended for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) or anti-dragon shield.
​ </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/vE1ZG0djXT.png <nowiki>Click to view an example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Frostfire Breath</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ A freezing type of dragonfire, which binds the player in place for a short duration.
    • Note: This attack can hit up to 1,000 damage through </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492695997513748.png?v=1" alt="superantifire" title="superantifire" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/pF0ng6BOhZ.webp <nowiki>Click to view an example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Toxic Breath</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ A venomous type of dragonfire, which inflicts the player with poison </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> This can be mitigated by a variety of antipoison potions </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588884406272.png?v=1" alt="superantipoison" title="superantipoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Note: This attack can hit up to 1,000 damage through </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492695997513748.png?v=1" alt="superantifire" title="superantifire" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
​ </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/7D8Ti9iVps.png <nowiki>Click to view an example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Charged Breath</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ A shocking type of dragonfire that deals dragonfire damage, as well as slightly reducing your skill levels and prayer points.
    • Note: This attack can hit up to 1,000 damage through </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492695997513748.png?v=1" alt="superantifire" title="superantifire" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
​ </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/KlRFWMU11K.webp <nowiki>Click to view an example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=huMj1Vo3XAJi6BhZkzgu <nowiki>Magic preset</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/19ce700a3579da7f0a848322cc646c7e83411331b84868beb0016160fc5a6bb7.webp" alt="King Black dragon basic magic" kind="addition" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>

</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FzNOontl68LmQpELThf5v.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="tips-and-tricks"><ins><nowiki>Tips and Tricks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The King Black Dragon's mechanics are mostly accounted for via good preparation such as bringing protection from dragonfire. During the fight you'll be largely focused on dealing good damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you have access to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551452788269127.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommelee" title="protectfrommelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, use it and stand in melee distance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Don't forget to use any damage-boosting prayers you have available!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Your options for dealing damage will vary greatly depending on your gear and unlocked abilities. The below are guidelines, assuming no expensive unlocks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Build adrenaline (and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1" alt="necrosis" title="necrosis" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) and use strong threshold abilities when available:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: wild magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and asphyxiate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try combust </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1" alt="comb" title="comb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and stepping under KBD!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: assault </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1" alt="assault" title="assault" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and destroy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1" alt="destroy" title="destroy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or hurricane </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try Slaughter </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879237873666.png?v=1" alt="slaughter" title="slaughter" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and stepping under KBD!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: snapshot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and rapid fire </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try fragmentation shot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541273755385885.png?v=1" alt="frag" title="frag" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and stepping under KBD!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: finger of death </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and volley of souls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Having your skeleton </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1" alt="conjureskeleton" title="conjureskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , ghost </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1" alt="conjureghost" title="conjureghost" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , and bloat </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> active is also a good idea.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
